WITH source_counts AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(ss.domainregistry) as spatial_count
  FROM scanspatial ss
  JOIN projects p ON ss.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
total_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(spatial_count) as total_count,
    AVG(spatial_count) as avg_count
  FROM source_counts
)
SELECT 
  sc.fundflux,
  sc.spatial_count,
  CAST(sc.spatial_count AS FLOAT) / ts.total_count as share,
  sc.spatial_count - ts.avg_count as above_average
FROM source_counts sc
CROSS JOIN total_stats ts
WHERE sc.spatial_count > ts.avg_count
ORDER BY sc.spatial_count DESC
